framework_target: LlamaCloud Self-Hosted Helm chart 0.9.0 and maintained LlamaCloud SDKs
evidence_boundary: Source and documentation accuracy only; no Enterprise license, live Kubernetes cluster, identity provider, LLM contract, or production workload was validated.

findings.details: The skill records the Enterprise license gate, Kubernetes 1.28+, Helm 3.7+, Linux amd64, documented starting capacity, production GPU recommendation, object storage, and required Postgres, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, and Temporal dependencies.
The skill uses the public run-llama Helm repository and the llamaindex/llamacloud chart, and explicitly marks the older enterprise repository and chart name as deprecated for new work.

The skill uses the maintained llama-cloud>=1.0 Python distribution (llama_cloud import namespace) and @llamaindex/llama-cloud for TypeScript, with a verification step for private or regional base URL configuration in the installed version.

The skill uses the authenticated regional LlamaParse MCP endpoints, classifies the current unified upload, Parse, Classify, Split, Extract, regex/file-search, and hybrid retrieval tools by side effect, and marks the archived llamacloud-mcp demo as unsuitable for a new implementation.

The skill separates metadata databases from Index targets; preserves source revision, ACL, deletion state, and provenance for Google Drive, Notion, GitHub, Linear, and Hugging Face ingestion; routes exact regex before hybrid semantic retrieval; and covers pgvector, MongoDB Search, Azure AI Search, Turbopuffer, custom export, observability, performance, rollout, rollback, and data-preserving incident response.
The integration preserves the Medusa route-to-workflow layering, idempotency, compensation, callback verification, provider abstraction, and evidence boundaries.
